categories.name: Bid Boxes / Favor Boxes
categories.intro: Our signature bid boxes are the little hand-printed keepsakes you hand to every guest as they leave. Two-piece lids, satin ribbon and floral block prints — perfect for Nikkah (the marriage ceremony), Walima receptions and Mehndi nights. Fill them with mithai, dry fruit, chocolates or trinkets.
categories.imageAlt: Stack of handmade pink hand-printed favor boxes with ribbon

specs.finish: Matte hand block print, gold-foil name tag optional

categories.name: Tin Boxes
categories.intro: Tin boxes are durable, reusable and feel instantly premium in the hand — ideal for sweets, dry fruit and chocolate gifting. Each lid is hand-printed or hand-painted, so guests keep them long after the event.
categories.imageAlt: Round rose gold floral hand-painted tin gift boxes

specs.material: Food-safe reusable tin with printed lid
specs.size: Approx. 4 inch diameter x 2 inch depth
specs.finish: Matte lid print, wipe-clean and reusable

categories.name: Sweet Boxes
categories.short: Mithai and dessert boxes with compartments.
categories.intro: Built for mithai, barfi, chocolates and dessert portions with neat compartments and sturdy lids. A favourite for Walima (the reception hosted after the wedding) and Aqeeqa distributions where boxes travel between homes.
categories.imageAlt: Open handmade salmon sweet box with gold detailing and mithai

categories.name: Baby Announcement Boxes
categories.intro: Soft pastel boxes to announce your newest arrival, made for Aqeeqa (the celebration held for a newborn) and baby showers. Hand-printed clouds, stars and tiny bows — personalised with baby's name on request.
categories.imageAlt: Pastel pink and mint baby announcement gift boxes with bows

specs.material: Rigid board with ribbon tie and name card
specs.finish: Hand-stamped motifs, personalised baby name card

categories.name: Nikkah Signs & Qubool Hai Pens
categories.short: Gold calligraphy props for the signing moment.
categories.intro: The Nikkah signing is the single most photographed minute of the whole wedding. Our hand-cut “Qubool Hai” pens, feather toppers and calligraphy signs are made in gold mirror-finish with fresh-flower gota wrapping, so the bride and groom hold something beautiful in every frame.
categories.imageAlt: Gold Qubool Hai calligraphy pens with white feather and gota flower wrap

specs.material: Acrylic / MDF sign, metal pen with resin topper
specs.size: Sign approx. 8 inches, pen standard length
specs.finish: Hand-glittered calligraphy, name and date customisable

categories.name: Mehndi Handheld Signs
categories.short: Round embroidered boards for the baraat entry.
categories.intro: Handheld round signs for the Mehndi and Baraat entrance — “Meri Behen Ki Mehndi”, “Dulhay Ki Saliyan”, or any line you want in Urdu or English. Velvet or embroidered base, gota-kinari border, tiny pom-poms and a wrapped handle. Made to be waved, danced with and photographed.
categories.imageAlt: Green embroidered round Mehndi handheld sign with gold Urdu calligraphy

specs.finish: Hand-cut lettering, glitter or matte finish

categories.name: Bazuband Armbands
categories.short: MashAllah armbands for the bride and groom.
categories.intro: Matching bazuband armbands worn on the sleeve at Mayun, Mehndi and Nikkah. Velvet base with hand-embroidered “MashAllah” in zari, mirror work and gota edging, finished with adjustable ties so they sit perfectly on any sleeve.
categories.imageAlt: Green velvet MashAllah bazuband armbands worn by a couple at their Mayun

specs.material: Velvet base with gota, pearls and zari work
specs.size: Adjustable tie, fits most arm sizes
specs.finish: Hand-embellished, sold as a matching pair

categories.name: Velvet Nameplates & Wall Hangings
categories.intro: Deep velvet panels with hand-glittered zari calligraphy, mirror-studded gota borders and hanging cords — “MashAllah”, “Ayat-ul-Kursi”, family names or a wedding date. Made as a decor piece for the event and a keepsake for the home afterwards.
categories.imageAlt: Two maroon velvet MashAllah plaques with gold glitter calligraphy and gota borders

specs.material: Velvet panel on board with hanging cord
specs.finish: Hand-glittered zari calligraphy with gota border

categories.name: Cone Favours (Dholki & Baat Pakki)
categories.intro: Clear cone favours filled with sonf, supari or colourful mishri, sealed with satin ribbon and finished with a printed tag carrying your name and date — “Filza Ki Dholki”, “Baat Pakki”, “Dua-e-Khair”. The fastest, prettiest giveaway for Dholki nights, Baat Pakki and Mehndi trays.
categories.imageAlt: Hand holding two clear cone favours of colourful mishri with pink Dholki tags

specs.material: Food-grade clear cone, satin ribbon, printed tag
specs.finish: Filled with sonf, supari or mishri; name and date printed

categories.name: Qubool Hai Nikkah Favours
categories.short: Acrylic jars and chocolate boxes for the Nikkah.
categories.intro: Nikkah-day giveaways built around one line: “Qubool Hai”. Clear acrylic keepsake jars with dry fruit and a personalised sage label, plus slim gold-foiled chocolate boxes for Baat Pakki and Dua-e-Khair. Names and date printed on every piece; plain customisable versions also available.
categories.imageAlt: Clear acrylic Qubool Hai favour jar with sage label filled with dry fruit

specs.material: Clear acrylic jar or rigid gold-foiled board box
specs.size: Jar approx. 2.5 inches; box approx. 6 x 2 inches
specs.finish: Personalised label with couple's names and Nikkah date
